REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning rather than re-route: I picked Plover because the request is a constrained, low-latitude task (append bibliography entries for an author starting with "R" in the existing citation format, with an explicit "no fluff" instruction), which aligns with Plover's self-reported strength in well-specified reformatting/extraction work.
